sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applicants FROM applicants;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hired_count FROM applicants WHERE is_hired = 1;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_hired) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_days_to_hire),2) AS avg_days_to_hire FROM applicants WHERE is_hired = 1;
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(is_hired) AS FLOAT)/COUNT(*)*100,2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants WHERE source='Referral';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hires_from_linkedin FROM applicants WHERE source = 'LinkedIn' AND is_hired = 1;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_hired=1)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants WHERE source='Job Fair';
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants WHERE source='Job Fair';
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants WHERE source='Job Fair';
SELECT source, ROUND(CAST(SUM(is_hired) AS REAL)/COUNT(*)*100,2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants GROUP BY source;

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT applicant_id) AS interview_reached FROM funnel_events WHERE stage='Interview';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT applicant_id) AS offer_reached FROM applicants WHERE offered_date IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rejected_at_applied FROM applicants WHERE rejected_at_stage = 'Applied';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS still_in_process FROM applicants WHERE final_status IS NULL OR final_status NOT IN ('hired','rejected')
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(*)*100,2) AS hire_rate_percent FROM applicants WHERE applied_date <= '2026-06-30';
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM funnel_events GROUP BY stage;
SELECT recruiter, COUNT(*) AS hires FROM applicants WHERE is_hired = 1 GROUP BY recruiter ORDER BY hires DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_hired) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hire_rate FROM applicants;

WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT source,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hired
  FROM applicants
  GROUP BY source
)
SELECT source,
       ROUND(100.0 * hired / total, 2) AS hire_rate
FROM source_stats
ORDER BY hire_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_hired = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hiring_rate FROM applicants;
